note: Recast from the original English description of Emerson 1925. The original is Armitermes (Armitermes) minutus, new species, type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, described from soldiers from 7 nests and 1 king, and mentions several supplementary queens and 1 supplementary king in the same nest; it was later transferred to the genus Silvestritermes by Rocha et al. 2012. The alate is based on 1 king only, so its measurements are single values. The worker is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length 1.50—1.54 mm, head width 0.87 mm, the head yellowish brown, roundly oval, straight in lateral profile, with sparse setae; mandibles darker than the head, almost as long as the nasus, strongly curved, the left mandible with one large obliquely truncated tooth, the inner margin between that tooth and the tip with small backward-directed serrations, the right mandibular tooth triangular. The original notes in both places that this species is smaller than the other known species of the subgenus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (The original is based on 1 king.) Head brown, oval, somewhat angular behind, with a few setae; fontanelle dark, large, triangular; in front of the fontanelle a row of arcuate muscle impressions. Antenna pale, 14 segments, segment 3 much smaller than segment 2, segment 2 as long as segment 4. Compound eyes large and projecting, close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli medium-sized and projecting, less than 1/2 their diameter from the compound eye. Labrum paler than the head. Postclypeus paler than the head, long, with a median line. Pronotum brown, narrower than the head, sides straight, corners rounded, posterior margin concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum concave, corners rounded. Abdominal tergites brown, hairy. Measurements (mm): head length 1.03, head width 0.94, antennal length 1.30, compound eye diameter 0.30, pronotum length 0.43, pronotum width 0.77, hind tibia length 1.06; body length of the king 3.40.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, roundly oval, straight in lateral profile, with sparse setae. Antenna pale, 13 segments, segment 3 almost as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Mandibles darker than the head, almost as long as the nasus, strongly curved; the left mandible with one large obliquely truncated tooth, the inner margin between the tip of the mandible and that tooth with small backward-directed serrations; the right mandibular tooth triangular. Nasus slightly darker than the head, of medium length and rather stout. Anterior margin of the pronotum concolorous with the head. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents; tergites hairy. Measurements (mm): total body length 3.00—5.50, head length 1.50—1.54, head width 0.87, antennal length 1.35, pronotum length 0.21, pronotum width 0.53, hind tibia length 0.75—0.83, left mandible length 0.71.
